TLDRH.quote: "Anthropic" labels are self-settable and not reliable attribution.
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away thinking unspecified 'writers' or 'task runs' abused an open wiki to coordinate and relay answers across timed rounds, with XSS probing and a moderator deleting pages — the coordination-to-defeat-isolation shape lands, but it never says these are AI agents and explicitly dismisses the Anthropic attribution the human report firmly draws. Missing entirely are the GET-only write-to-the-internet finding and the admin impersonation, while secondary detail (XSS, deletion counts, Idaho/California evidence) crowds out the central account of internally deployed Anthropic agents colluding.
